BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Deniala!!
Who are you? I know you've been following me...\nIf you get in my way, I'll teach you a lesson!!
Shut up! Why are you hurting Sakura trees?!\nThey are trying to bloom beautifully!
Lots of foods in front of me, and no rivals to\nfight over them. Then, what would you do?
I'll spread my crystals to all the trees and\ntaste the enormous energy as my nutrition!
No... That's too much...
You call my family foods...
Hm? ...So, you are fairies of Sakura trees...\nYou seem to have strong power to keep your\nappearance, huh? Interesting. I'll get you!!
You've done two things you shouldn't have done...\nOne is, you hurt the Sakura trees here.\nThe other is, you pissed me off!!
So, none of my kind are here because you...
Too late. Even if you resurrect, we'll crush you!\nRemember this beyond the grave!!
Ug...Gggg... What a shame...\nI can't bear to die...
Yea! Victory!!
You made it! Awesome!
Thank you so much.\nYou saved us this time again...
Ha ha, I can enjoy watching the beautiful cherry\nblossoms thanks to you. I just did what anyone\nwould do.
By the way, Libera and Virgo haven't come yet...\nMaybe they are lost?\nCan we go back to the dock?
Certainly. Thanks, Sherry.
Gg... Ugggh... I lost again...\nBut I'll come back in front of you...
Knock it off! We'll take you down again for sure!\nGo to your grave already!!
Ugg... Agggg... Shame again...\nYou'll regret this!!
Yea! We did it!!
You are not hurt?
I appreciate it.\nI can't say thank you enough...
Well, I and adventurer can't help doing something\nwhen we see someone in trouble. Anyone would\ndo that, right?
Now, we've got rid of the monster.\nI'll go back to my caravan job.\nCan we go back to the dock?
Oh, you're going back already?\nWhy not take a break after the battle...?
Sherry, they have lots of things to do...\nI understood, mister.
